answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 4502 Country: United States of America Title: During the masjid jamaat if small children (not offering namaz) come in front of imam is the namaz valid. 2.during the masjid jamaat if small children ( are offering namaz) come in front of imam is the namaz valid. 3. same above questions but not in masjid but in house. Question: During the masjid jamaat if small children (not offering namaz) come in front of imam is the namaz valid. 2.during the masjid jamaat if small children ( are offering namaz) come in front of imam is the namaz valid. 3. same above questions but not in masjid but in house. Answer ID: 4502 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1575/1198=H/1429) (1, 2, 3) The salah is valid in all the cases. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
